# Mengva Chuepor

> Full-stack web developer based in Vientiane, Laos, working mainly in
> TypeScript across Next.js, Hono, tRPC, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL.
> Focused on booking, rental, and operations systems for tourism and
> hospitality businesses in Southeast Asia.

This site is a single-page developer portfolio. All content lives on
one page (/) split into the sections below. There are no other pages.

## Sections
- About: background and technical focus.
- Work: three projects — Brother Tours (Full-Stack Developer Screening
  Challenge), Brother Tours (Tour Management System), and Yerlee
  (Rental Management System, final year project). Each includes the
  tech stack used and what was built.
- Skills: languages, frontend, backend, database/ORM, and tools.
- Education: Bachelor of Science in Web Development, National
  University of Laos (2022–2026).
- Contact: email, phone, and GitHub.
